params.body:
A page **Accounts** under System, for the accounts of gentells.com.

- **Per account:** name, address, since when, plan, trial, reads in the last 30 days, last seen, and newsletter status.
- **Actions:**
  - the plan is a select;
  - **More** gives: a 14-day trial, end the trial, block or unblock.
  - team accounts show their plan as team and are managed under Team.
- **Summary and log:** a line counts the accounts per plan, and **Recent changes** lists who changed what.
- **Navigation:** System now holds Pipeline, Analytics, **Accounts**, **Team** (its own address, `/team`, instead of three clicks under Settings) and Settings.

Needs gentells-pipeline (relay) and gentells-site (internal routes) merged first.

Checked: build, lint at its ceiling, e2e 28 passing (new `accounts.spec.js`: the list renders and a plan change posts).
params.title: Accounts page; Accounts and Team in the System menu
